Affordable and Professional Bathtub Remodels Choosing the right bathtub is one of the most important parts of your remodel. We offer a range of options designed to match your style and daily needs. Freestanding Tub Trends Modern Freestanding Tubs : Sleek, sculptural designs that act as a focal point in your bathroom. Ideal for open layouts and luxury upgrades. Classic Clawfoot Tubs : Timeless style that adds character while providing a deep, relaxing soak. Minimalist Designs : Clean lines and neutral finishes that complement contemporary spaces. Soaking Tubs for Relaxation Deep Soaking Tubs : Designed for full-body immersion, offering a spa-like experience at home. Ergonomic Shapes : Built for comfort with contoured back support. Heat-Retaining Materials : Help maintain water temperature longer for extended relaxation. Built-In Tub Options Alcove Tubs : Space-saving solutions ideal for standard bathroom layouts. Drop-In Tubs : Installed within a custom deck, allowing for added storage and design flexibility. Tub-to-Shower Conversion Process Many homeowners in Richmond, TX, are choosing to replace traditional bathtubs with walk-in showers for better accessibility and modern design. Our Conversion Process Includes: Initial Consultation : Evaluate your space, plumbing, and goals for the remodel. Design Planning : Select shower layout, tile, fixtures, and glass enclosure options. Demolition : Remove the existing bathtub and prepare the space. Waterproofing and Prep : Install moisture barriers and ensure proper drainage systems. Installation : Add tile, fixtures, glass, and finishing details with precision. Final Walkthrough : Confirm everything meets quality standards and functions properly.
